🚀 HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Avvia l'app:
   python main.py

2. Menu bar → ⚙️ Preferenze

3. Seleziona tema:
   • 🌙 Modalità Scura (dark)
   • ☀️ Modalità Chiara (light)

4. ✨ L'app cambia istantaneamente!

🎨 COLORS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DARK THEME              LIGHT THEME
─────────────          ──────────────
#1e1e1e (bg)           #ffffff (bg)
#e0e0e0 (text)         #1e1e1e (text)
#0066cc (button)       #0066cc (button)
#3d3d3d (border)       #cccccc (border)
#2d2d2d (menu)         #f5f5f5 (menu)

🧪 TESTING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Test 1: Validate stylesheets
  cd volley_analizer
  python test_theme/test_theme_toggle.py

Test 2: Interactive demo
  python test_theme/test_ui_demo.py

Test 3: Full app
  python main.py
  → ⚙️ Preferenze → 🎨 Tema → [Toggle]


📊 IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Class: VolleyballScoutApp (in app_dark.py)

Instance Variables:
  • self.is_dark_theme = True (current theme state)
  • self.theme_actions = {} (stores QAction references)

Methods:
  • _create_menu_bar() - Creates the menu with theme options
  • _toggle_theme(is_dark) - Switches theme instantly

Stylesheets:
  • DARK_STYLESHEET - Dark colors (#1e1e1e bg)
  • LIGHT_STYLESHEET - Light colors (#ffffff bg)

Signal Flow:
  User clicks menu → _toggle_theme(bool) → app.setStyleSheet() → Update checkmarks


🔄 TOGGLE FLOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. User clicks ⚙️ Preferenze → 🎨 Tema → [Option]
2. QAction.triggered signal emitted
3. _toggle_theme(is_dark) called with bool
4. app.setStyleSheet() applies new stylesheet
5. All widgets instantly update colors
6. Menu checkmarks updated
7. is_dark_theme state updated
8. Debug print: 🌙 or ☀️

Result: Instant theme change, no lag, all UI synced!


💡 QUICK CODE SNIPPETS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Import stylesheets:
  from volleyball_scout.ui.app_dark import DARK_STYLESHEET, LIGHT_STYLESHEET

Apply theme:
  app = QApplication.instance()
  app.setStyleSheet(DARK_STYLESHEET)  # or LIGHT_STYLESHEET

Toggle programmatically:
  self._toggle_theme(False)  # Switch to light
  self._toggle_theme(True)   # Switch to dark

Check current theme:
  if self.is_dark_theme:
      print("Dark theme active")


🚨 TROUBLESHOOTING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Q: Theme not changing?
A: Check that _toggle_theme() is being called and stylesheets are defined

Q: Colors look wrong?
A: Verify DARK/LIGHT_STYLESHEET are imported from app_dark.py

Q: Menu items out of sync?
A: Ensure theme_actions dict is populated and setChecked() is called

Q: App crashes?
A: Check PyQt6 is installed: pip install PyQt6

Q: Can't find menu?
A: Look for ⚙️ Preferenze in menu bar (between Visualizza and Aiuto)
